info.title: XRPay Cashier API
info.description: Server-to-server API for payments, consolidated balances, bank and Mobile Money payouts, payroll, refunds, and signed webhooks. Test credentials use isolated virtual balances: a successful local-currency payment simulation can fund a test payout, and executing that payout never contacts a bank or Mobile Money network. Payment-intent amounts are integer minor units; payout and payroll amounts are exact decimal strings. Provider identities and custody allocations are never exposed.

post.description: Use only when a direct Mobile Money intent returns next_action.type=submit_otp. Most networks instead return approve_on_phone and require no confirmation API call.

200.description: One-time code accepted; payment confirmation remains asynchronous

post.summary: Simulate a test payment outcome
post.description: Available only with test credentials. No external payment or ledger transaction is submitted. A successful local-currency simulation credits the connected business's isolated test payout balance exactly once; the PaymentIntent response describes that credit in test_balance_credit. Crypto-settlement simulations do not create a local-currency payout balance.

post.summary: Create a full or partial refund
post.description: Live XRPay refunds are non-custodial and enter requires_action until the merchant approves and signs them.

post.summary: Simulate a test refund outcome

get.description: Returns available, retained minimum, amount above that minimum, reserved, in-flight, pending, and destination-specific withdrawable decimal amounts without revealing custody providers. Test credentials return only isolated virtual test balances; live and test balances never mix.

get.summary: List payout corridors and aggregate limits
List canonical banks and Mobile Money operators
get.description: With a test API key, country=GH, currency=GHS, and type=bank or type=mobile_money returns the matching XRPay simulated destination. Its test_mode field is true; no real bank or Mobile Money operator is implied or contacted. Live keys never return simulator institutions.

post.summary: Create or reuse a payout destination
post.description: Creates setup data only and does not move funds. Requires a stable Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Quote an exact-net or maximum-balance payout
post.description: Creates an expiring quote without moving funds. Payout-balance quotes subtract the account's retained minimum before calculating withdrawable funds. The response aggregates internal custody legs and exposes fees and transfer count, never provider names. With test credentials, simulated is true and test_mode_notice states that execution will not send external money.

post.summary: Atomically reserve and execute a quoted payout
post.description: With live credentials, this is a money-moving operation: XRPay validates the quote, reserves the total debit, and submits the bank or Mobile Money payout. With test credentials, XRPay changes only isolated virtual balances, contacts no external financial network, and returns external_transfer_sent=false.

post.description: The signing secret is returned only when the endpoint is first created; updating the same URL never reveals it again. Test and live credentials create separate endpoints, even for the same URL.

bearerAuth.description: Secret API key or XRPay Connect access token.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable key for one logical operation. Reusing a key with different parameters returns HTTP 409.

amount_minor.description: Fiat amount in the currency's smallest unit.

payment_method_types.description: Optional allow-list enforced by both the hosted checkout UI and server actions.

collection_mode.description: Use direct with mobile_money to send the approval prompt to the customer's phone without creating a hosted checkout page.

payment_method_data.description: Required only for direct Mobile Money collection. The full phone number is used for submission but is never returned.

expires_in.description: Relative expiry in seconds. Mutually exclusive with expires_at.

expires_at.description: Absolute expiry at least 60 seconds and no more than 30 days ahead. Mutually exclusive with expires_in.

phone.description: Customer Mobile Money number. E.164 with country code is recommended.

test_balance_credit.description: Present after a successful local-currency test simulation. Null for live intents, unsuccessful simulations, and crypto-settlement simulations.

TestBalanceCredit.description: An idempotent credit to the connected business's isolated virtual payout balance. It never represents external money movement.

idempotent_replay.description: True when the same successful simulation was replayed and no second balance entry was created.

amount_minor.description: Omit to refund the remaining refundable amount.

MoneyString.description: An exact non-negative decimal amount. Never parse this as a binary floating-point number.

test_mode.description: True only for an XRPay simulated destination. It does not identify a real bank or Mobile Money operator.

simulated.description: True when the quote uses an isolated test balance.

test_mode_notice.description: For test quotes, confirms that execution will not send money to a bank or Mobile Money wallet. Null for live quotes.

estimated_delivery_seconds.description: Aggregate delivery estimate for the slowest internal transfer part, when every part has an estimate.

Payout.description: One merchant-facing payout. Delivery IDs are opaque and never identify a provider.

simulated.description: True when the payout changes only isolated test balances.

external_transfer_sent.description: Always false for test payouts. Null for live payouts because delivery state is represented by status and deliveries.

status_message.description: For test payouts, explicitly confirms that no external bank or Mobile Money transfer was sent. Null for live payouts.

PayrollRun.description: A single-currency payroll run. Each payment is indivisible and uses exactly one internal custody pool.

WebhookEvent.description: The id/webhook_id remains stable across all attempts and replay operations.

secret.description: Signing secret. Returned only when an endpoint is first created.
